t: You are outside St Anne's Church, the Church of England parish church of Soho. It was consecrated on 21 March 1686 by Bishop Henry Compton, for a new parish carved out of St Martin in the Fields. The architect William Talman designed it. Several interesting people are buried here. Dorothy L. Sayers, the crime writer, is one. Theodore of Corsica, a German adventurer who was briefly King of Corsica, is another. So is Sir Edmund Andros, who governed the Dominion of New England. The painters William Hamilton and George Samuel are buried here too.
